verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Adyen's official OpenAPI repository, which recommends importing the API definition into Postman to build runnable requests. That gives you runnable calls only through a third-party tool, not a first-party interactive reference. The probe also found no OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer with in-browser runnable examples, risk-API-specific reference pages with try-it functionality, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
